The '''''Solidarity''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ''Solidarity'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ezar Elasra]] and was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ralen (Human)|Ralen]]. During the conflict, the ''Solidarity'' was damaged in a battle and while it was being repaired, a group of Republic agents traveled to the ship in a [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]]. Elasra had been tasked with retaking the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and he briefed the agents on a mission that he was going to send them on, to reactivate an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] that was located on the planet. The agents then left the ''Solidarity'' in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/stealth/Legends|LAAT/s]], along with some [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], to carry out their assignment.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

The agents activated the cannon and it opened fire on the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was orbiting Tirahnn. Elasra immediately brought the ''Solidarity'' and the rest of his [[Battle group|battlegroup]] out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near to the world, beginning the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]]. About thirty minutes into the battle, the crew of the ''Solidarity'' contacted the agents over a secure channel, commanding them to allow the cannon to be placed under the Star Destroyer's direct control. Elasra then spoke to the agents via a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and sent them to place some [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] on some CIS tanks, so that the ''Solidarity'' could fire on the vehicles, preventing the threat that the tanks posed to the Republic forces on the planet. Elasra also dispatched a team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to transport the captured Separatist [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Zolghast]] to the ''Solidarity''.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
